items.text:
Incident Report: Server Outage on 12 April

At 09:32 UTC, monitoring alerted on elevated error rates for the booking API. The outage lasted 22 minutes and affected approximately 8% of requests. The root cause was a misconfigured load balancer rule that directed traffic to an unhealthy pool. The rule was rolled back at 09:54 UTC, and services recovered by 10:02 UTC.

During the incident, the support team received 14 customer complaints, mostly about failed payment attempts. The payment gateway remained operational; the errors were due to retries hitting the wrong endpoint. A fix is scheduled for the next maintenance window.

Lessons learned: health check thresholds need adjustment, and the rollback procedure should be automated. The incident commander has requested a follow-up review.
